# OpenBSD-only expected failures. See common.txt for the shared ones and
# README.md for what may go in here.

# UNLIKE EVERY OTHER ENTRY IN THESE FILES, THIS IS NOT A PROPERTY OF THE
# MACHINE. It is an unexplained intermittent failure in ooRexx itself, listed
# so that the rest of the suite can gate, and it should be removed once someone
# works out what it is.
#
# The native API exit handler tests fail on OpenBSD roughly one run in three,
# on a different test each time. Six consecutive runs of the group in a local
# OpenBSD 7.8 VM, same build, as an unprivileged user:
#
#   run 1  54 tests  0 failures
#   run 2  54 tests  1 failure   TESTEXEIOEXITSAY
#   run 3  54 tests  0 failures
#   run 4  54 tests  0 failures
#   run 5  54 tests  1 failure   TESTCONTEXTNOVALUEEXIT
#   run 6  54 tests  0 failures
#
# Earlier full-suite runs failed TESTINITEXIT and TESTDLLQUEUEEXITQUEUE in the
# same group. Because the test that fails moves, naming individual tests would
# neither match reliably nor say what is actually wrong, so the whole group is
# listed. That does mean a real regression anywhere in these 54 tests would be
# hidden, which is the cost of keeping the other 24310 gating.
ProcessInvocation.testGroup/*
